title: A Forest in Balance
instruction: Link West to East for the squirrel, and secure homes for the hornbill and the gliding frog.
intro: The road splits the forest. A hornbill pair needs its nest tree and a fruiting fig; gliding frogs need streamside forest. One route cannot fix everything — prioritise together.

events.title: Lantana spreads east
events.text: Lantana is moving along the east patch edge. Marked cells degrade at round end unless cleared.

events.title: Lantana reaches the nest tree
events.text: The thicket now threatens the hornbill nest tree itself.
